subject: Marketplace catalog entry & channel ops — onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@consultify.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace co-promotion: listing checklist & tech certs

Hi Karthik / Vanessa,

Thanks again for taking a look at Consultify's integration. Our channel team is keen to get a joint listing into AWS and GCP marketplaces and to surface a co-sell option for enterprise accounts. To move quickly we need to align on the catalog entry requirements, the technical evidence you provide, and the co-marketing assets.

High level asks from our side:
- Published listing metadata (SKU, short/long descriptions, pricing model)
- Security/compliance artifacts for the listing page (SOC2 summary, data handling blurb)
- A technical evidence bundle we can link to from the marketplace (deployment diagrams, demo image, sample CloudFormation/Terraform snippets)
- Joint GTM brief for co-sell motions and the uplift model

Can we do a 30-min call next week to map responsibilities? I attached a short partnership one-pager for context (partnership-onepager.pdf).

Also copying Jordan Patel at CloudBroker — they are helping us with marketplace ops and will coordinate the marketplace intake forms.

Cheers,
Maria
Head of Alliances | Consultify

Attachment: partnership-onepager.pdf (1 page)
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@consultify.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-promotion: listing checklist & tech certs

Maria — thanks for the clear list and the one-pager, this is exactly the right starting point. We'd like to own the listing metadata and the co-sell playbook jointly. Proposed next steps:

1) Quick sync (30m) to align on roles — Wed 10/28 10:00am PT or Thu 10/29 2:00pm PT. Please confirm.
2) We'll prepare a first-pass draft of listing metadata (short long descriptions, bullets, tags) — I will circulate a draft by Fri 10/30.
3) Marcus, can you collect the technical evidence items Maria listed (diagram, demo image, CF/Terraform example, SOC2 summary) and drop in the shared Drive by Mon 11/1?
4) Laura, can you confirm the legal entity name and preferred billing model for the listing (SaaS hourly vs. subscription)?

I'm attaching an internal draft metadata file to speed the review (draft-listing-metadata.md).

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Karthik
Head of Channel Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachment: draft-listing-metadata.md (text)

Subject: Re: Marketplace — tech artifacts needed (internal)

Marcus / Laura — looping you both in to capture immediate owners for the artifacts. Short asks below.

Marcus: technical evidence pack — target drop in Drive by Mon 11/1
- Architecture diagram (high level + deployment variants for dedicated vs. cloud-hosted)
- Demo screenshot + short walkthrough (300–400 words)
- Example infra snippets (CloudFormation + Terraform, minimal bootstrap templates)
- Performance profile summary (typical latency at 1k and 5k tokens, GPU config)
- SOC2 summary / control owner contact (if we can provide a one-page blurb)
- Note any data residency or encryption caveats for the marketplace listing page

Laura: legal/billing check — confirm the listing entity name, PO contact, and whether Consultify prefers Marketplace SaaS contract or direct billing. If we need a partner reseller agreement, flag it and I'll loop legal — target reply by Fri 10/30.

Keep replies short — we want to share a compact intake bundle for the marketplace intake form.

Karthik

Subject: Marketplace intake — technical evidence bundle uploaded

Hi all,

I've uploaded the technical evidence bundle to the shared Drive and attached a zip for convenience (aws-technical-evidence.zip). Contents summary:
- architecture-diagram.png (2 variants: hosted, dedicated)
- demo-walkthrough.txt (short script + 3 screenshots)
- cf-template-sample.yaml
- terraform-sample.tf
- performance-summary.csv (latency/throughput for 1k/5k tokens on p4/p3/4xlarge)
- soc2-summary.pdf (one-page summary)

Known caveat: the CloudFormation sample references an SSM parameter we still need to parameterize for customers that require VPC endpoints. Jordan at CloudBroker has the parameterization pattern; tagging him here to confirm.

Attachments: aws-technical-evidence.zip (multi-file)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cConsultify-Marketplace-Onboarding

Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace intake — next steps and DocuSign for co-sell agreement

Hi Maria / Karthik / team,

Thanks for the upload — we've reviewed the technical artifacts and the metadata draft. Two small asks before we publish the listing:

1) Pricing schema: please change the billing plan name in draft-listing-metadata.md from "usage-hourly" to "usage-per-0.1-credit" to match marketplace SKU taxonomy.
2) CloudFormation parameterization: replace the inline SSM reference with an input parameter (we marked the specific line in the CF sample).

I've sent a DocuSign powerform for the co-sell addendum and simplified reseller terms: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc123-co-sell
Our onboarding manager will schedule a 45-min co-sell kickoff on Tue 2026-11-10 10:00am PT; invite will follow.

Once you confirm the two items above, we'll move to final QA and catalog publication.

Regards,
Emily S.
Marketplace Onboarding | AWS Marketplace
